newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit trades in range on lack of new factors.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit trades in range on lack of new factors.

text.p: The ringgit was trading in a range against the dollar as the market waited for fresh leads to trade on, dealers said on Monday.
They said the market was mainly adjusting positions and trading for small commercial demand.
"Nothing much is happening. There is nothing new to trade on," said a dealer with a foreign bank in Kuala Lumpur.
He said there was little activity even in ringgit/Sing, which was in the unwinding mode last week.
Dealers said ringgit/Sing was headed down as investors were returning to the "safe haven" Singapore dollar.
At 0400 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4932/37 per dollar against 2.4935/40 at close on Friday. The Singapore dollar was at 0.5648/54 against 0.5654/60. - Madhav Reddy (603-230 8911)
